references.text: The Lord tells Moses that He will send an angel to protect and lead the people of Israel, which points to God's ability to send angels to carry out His will.
God will command His angels to protect the righteous, reflecting the idea of angels' protective role.
Daniel is protected by an angel in the lion's den, illustrating how God can send angels to protect His servants.
Peter is freed from prison by an angel, demonstrating God's ability to send angels to intervene and rescue.
